receipt.expected: An exterior cylinder Ø20 × 20 accepts metric coarse/fine, custom Unified UNC/UNF and rounded trapezoidal threads. Cosmetic preserves the geometry; Modeled adds a helix. Hand, start and length controls behave as expected.
receipt.actual: The planar cap was rejected; selecting the exterior wall chose M20×2.5 automatically. Length 21 was refused under Thread length. Length 8 in Cosmetic mode retained the 140-triangle shaft. Modeled produced a 1578-triangle helix. Left-hand plus Flip moved the helix to the opposite end; Undo restored right-hand without Flip and Redo restored left-hand with Flip exactly. Full modeled length 20 succeeded with 2996 triangles. Metric fine M20×2 succeeded with 1646 triangles. Unified Custom shaft diameter 20, pitch 2, TPI 12.7 and class 2A applied for UNC and UNF. Rounded trapezoidal radial depth 1, corner radius .15, clearances .125/.1 and length 8 succeeded with 6604 triangles and all 3 features OK. A transient native Busy inspection during the last Apply was handled by a fresh observation and later read-only inspection, without replaying input. Wrapped labels and a zero-radial-depth error under the wrong generic field awaited repair. Saved checkpoints were preserved; final UI reopen, Cancel and label qualification were pending. The final labels and zero-depth feedback passed on 75538377. Cancel preserved the whole saved model; UI Open restored the metric fixture exactly.
receipt.scope: Representative Ø20 shaft: metric coarse/fine, custom-diameter Unified UNC/UNF, and rounded trapezoidal. This does not qualify every stock size or parameter combination, export, or physical gestures.
